mapper.sql: b.status = 'ACCEPTED' AND b.processing_count = 0 AND b.rejected_count = 0 AND b.retryable_count = 0 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dashboard_integration_message protected_message WHERE protected_message.batch_id = b.batch_id AND protected_message.status != 'ACCEPTED')
mapper.select: SELECT b.batch_id FROM dashboard_integration_batch b WHERE b.integration_id = #{integrationId} AND AND b.expires_at <= #{now} AND b.raw_body_ciphertext IS NOT NULL ORDER BY b.expires_at, b.batch_id LIMIT #{limit} FOR UPDATE

SELECT m.integration_message_id FROM dashboard_integration_message m JOIN dashboard_integration_batch b ON b.batch_id = m.batch_id WHERE m.integration_id = #{integrationId} AND b.integration_id = #{integrationId} AND m.status = 'ACCEPTED' AND AND b.expires_at <= #{now} AND m.payload_ciphertext IS NOT NULL ORDER BY m.integration_message_id LIMIT #{limit} FOR UPDATE

SELECT m.integration_message_id FROM dashboard_integration_message m JOIN dashboard_integration_batch b ON b.batch_id = m.batch_id WHERE m.integration_id = #{integrationId} AND b.integration_id = #{integrationId} AND m.status = 'ACCEPTED' AND AND b.processed_at < #{cutoff} AND m.normalized_json IS NOT NULL ORDER BY m.integration_message_id LIMIT #{limit} FOR UPDATE

SELECT b.batch_id AS batchId, b.platform_request_id AS platformRequestId, b.message_id AS messageId, b.accepted_count AS acceptedCount, b.processing_count AS processingCount, b.duplicate_count AS duplicateCount, b.rejected_count AS rejectedCount, b.retryable_count AS retryableCount FROM dashboard_integration_batch b WHERE b.integration_id = #{integrationId} AND AND b.processed_at < #{cutoff} AND (b.details_expired_at IS NULL OR (b.raw_body_ciphertext IS NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dashboard_integration_message m WHERE m.batch_id = b.batch_id))) ORDER BY b.processed_at, b.batch_id LIMIT #{limit} FOR UPDATE

SELECT r.record_id FROM dashboard_integration_record r JOIN dashboard_integration_message m ON m.integration_id = r.integration_id AND m.profile = r.profile AND m.business_key = r.business_key JOIN dashboard_integration_batch b ON b.batch_id = m.batch_id WHERE r.integration_id = #{integrationId} AND r.updated_at < #{cutoff} AND r.status IN ('ACTIVE','DELETED') AND m.status = 'ACCEPTED' AND m.payload_hash IS NOT NULL AND b.integration_id = #{integrationId} AND ORDER BY r.updated_at, r.record_id LIMIT #{limit} FOR UPDATE
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM dashboard_integration_batch WHERE integration_id = #{integrationId} AND batch_id = #{batchId} AND status = 'ACCEPTED' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dashboard_integration_message m WHERE m.batch_id = #{batchId}) AND raw_body_ciphertext IS NULL
DELETE FROM dashboard_integration_record WHERE integration_id = #{integrationId} AND record_id IN #{id}
